story.hook: The statue wakes above the rooftop
story.caption_explanation_en: A pirate cartographer hangs safely upside down as a clockwork train restarts spring one tunnel at a time.

a statue's projected eyes open behind the hero
an adventurous ship leader with an original map

images.image_prompt: Ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, vertical 4:5 blockbuster frame on a rain-soaked neon megacity rooftop with towering original architecture. An attractive adult Korean Shorthair cheese-tabby cat; natural balanced sturdy build; bright warm orange short coat with realistic darker tabby stripes; clean white fur on muzzle and chin continuing naturally through neck, chest and belly; all four paws clean white from toes upward; a distinctive congenital orange cheese-tabby fur marking around the mouth resembling a curry stain, explicitly not food or dirt; round amber-brown eyes; pink nose; short dense fur; natural whiskers; slightly rounded cheeks; realistic memorable face. As an adventurous pirate cartographer captain in an original weatherproof captain coat with a hand-drawn map, the cat shows guilty caught-in-the-act expression and upside-down hang in a playful, securely supported film-set pose. A giant clock prop beside the cat contains a tiny engineer driving a second-hand train, restarting stopped time. Each tunnel opening behind it reveals progressively fuller cherry blossoms. A colossal original landmark statue behind the hero has projected eyes opening, creating a dramatic consequence. Camera distance five meters, inverted crane viewpoint, 24mm lens, deep focus across cat, clock, neon skyline, and statue, hard cyan-magenta rim lighting, rain droplets, wet reflections, realistic fur weight, paws, harness concealment, and clock metal. Safe supported pose and harmless projection, no strain or danger. Correct feline anatomy, no duplicate cats, no extra limbs, no human features, no cartoon, illustration, 3D render, plastic fur, logos, text, watermark, UI, captions, or readable title.
